## Goal
`status()` (`src/freemyid/scheduler/__init__.py:183-203`) says only installed or not. A helper on the phone needs "last ran on Monday, finished" or "last run failed". Add pure parsers and use them.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New `src/freemyid/scheduler/status_parse.py` with pure functions for `schtasks /query /v /fo LIST` output (Last Run Time, Last Result), `systemctl --user show -p LastTriggerUSec -p Result` output, and `launchctl print` output (last exit code). Each returns a small dataclass (when, outcome: ok / needs you (exit 3) / failed / never ran / unknown).
- `status()` appends one plain sentence from that result to today's text; the text it returns today stays as its first part, so `cli_json.schedule_doc` callers keep working.
- Parsers never raise on odd or localized output: unknown fields give "unknown", not an exception. Fake outputs (English plus one non-English Windows sample with the field names missing) prove it.
- Still no command runs in tests: `_run` is monkeypatched.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only.
